fundamentals.name: AST SpaceMobile, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: AST SpaceMobile, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and develops the constellation of BlueBird satellites in the United States. The company provides a cellular broadband network in space to be accessible directly by smartphones for commercial use and other applications, as well as for government use. Its SpaceMobile service provides cellular broadband services to end-users who are out of terrestrial cellular coverage. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Midland, Texas.

news.paragraph: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) has seen a significant surge of 21.6% since its last earnings report, with recent articles highlighting its potential to advance connectivity through upcoming satellite launches. While the company's revenue growth is exceptionally high year-over-year, its operating and profit margins remain deeply negative, and it posted a substantial EPS miss last quarter. The stock's performance and future trajectory appear heavily tied to its ambitious satellite deployment plans and market perception, with analysts holding a mixed 'hold' consensus.
